use_case_name: Initialize a Newly Online Control Unit

claims.content: To identify the control unit's cabinet ID, verify that all required I/O cards are present and functioning, perform a system integrity check, initialize device tables, and begin monitoring field devices.

goal.raw_text: To identify the control unit's cabinet ID, verify that all required I/O cards are present and functioning, perform a system integrity check, initialize device tables, and begin monitoring field devices.

claims.content: Control Unit
The control unit comes online.
The RLCS software shall first identify the cabinet ID when it starts by reading the cabinet ID.
The RLCS software shall then proceed to make sure that all the cards required in that unit are present and working properly.
The RLCS software will do a control system integrity check (see requirement 3.0.9) and initialize all the specified tables.
If everything is OK, the start-up process shall not exceed 30 seconds.
The RLCS software shall then monitor all the devices and send the current status to the FCU or TSU every 2 seconds (or at the rate specified in the System Control Parameters for the current mode).
If the control system integrity check (referenced in requirement 3.0.9) fails, the start-up process is halted.
If the start-up process exceeds 30 seconds, it is considered a failure.

In the event of a failure (from steps 2a or 3a), the system shall not proceed to monitor devices and send status updates as described in the main flow. Instead, it should handle the error condition, which may involve logging the failure and alerting operators, although the specific error handling actions are not detailed in this section.
If the control system integrity check (referenced in requirement 3.0.9) fails, the start-up process is halted.
If the start-up process exceeds 30 seconds, it is considered a failure and the process is halted.
In the event of a failure from steps 1 or 2, the system shall not proceed to monitor devices and send status updates as described in the main flow.
The control unit's cabinet ID has been successfully identified.
All required I/O cards in the unit have been verified as present and working properly.
A control system integrity check has been completed successfully.
All specified device tables have been initialized.
The start-up process completed within 30 seconds.
The software is actively monitoring all devices.
Current status is being sent to the FCU or TSU every 2 seconds (or at the rate specified in System Control Parameters).
